g.text: Blue: depth enclosing 99% of dye. Gray: no computed profile. All cases use the same fixed logarithmic concentration scale.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Model analog of Wagner et al. Fig. 8; no laboratory dye data are plotted. The column is 50 mm deep; C* = 1 is a uniformly mixed column.
